sources.excerpt: Big Fuzz by Fuhrmann | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Fuhrmann Big Fuzz LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ Description The Fuhrmann Big Fuzz is a versatile and powerful fuzz pedal that can add a unique sound to a musician’s playing style. Its ability to produce a wide range of tones and its strong sustain make it a popular choice among musicians.
